videos.title: The End of the Static Screen: Architecting Intent-Driven UX — Gus Iwanaga, commercetools
videos.summary: As AI shifts user interfaces from static layouts to generative, intent-driven experiences, software engineers face unpredictable outputs. This talk breaks down how to architect reliable UI systems that stay cohesive even when AI models drift.

videos.title: Agent Spending Without Controls — Rodrigo Coelho & Pranav Maheshwari, Edge & Node
videos.summary: Giving AI agents access to paid APIs and financial tools opens up powerful capabilities, but without proper controls, costs can spiral instantly. Learn how engineers build metered endpoints and execution boundaries for autonomous agents.

videos.title: Challenges of mixing object oriented and functional features
videos.summary: Martin Odersky breaks down the trade-offs of combining object-oriented and functional programming in production systems. Understanding these design tensions helps fullstack developers write cleaner, more maintainable code across any language.

videos.title: Agentic approaches to processing long videos with Gemini
videos.summary: Processing long multimodal inputs can destroy your LLM budget. This quick breakdown shows how using agentic video chunking with Gemini reduces token consumption and slashes latency in production.

videos.title: Agentic video understanding in Gemini
videos.summary: Learn how Google DeepMind implements agentic video processing in Gemini 3.5/3.7 Flash models. This technical walk-through demonstrates how to parse long-form video content efficiently while maintaining high retrieval accuracy.

videos.title: Apa hak kita jika loan kena reject?
videos.summary: When a bank rejects your loan application in Malaysia, you don't have to be left in the dark. Financial Faiz explains your rights as a borrower and how different financial institutions evaluate risk profiles.

videos.title: Jangan pinjamkan nama untuk joint loan?
videos.summary: Co-signing a joint loan for family members might seem like a noble gesture, but it severely limits your own financial freedom. This clip highlights how joint liabilities permanently affect your credit score and future home loan eligibility.

videos.title: [S01:E22]  Credit Card vs BNPL:  Mana sebenarnya lebih bahaya? - Norliza Rahmat & Fairuz Izwan
videos.summary: Navigating Buy Now Pay Later schemes and credit card limits is a major trap for early-career professionals in Malaysia. Financial experts break down how compounding commitments derail long-term goals like property ownership and investments.

videos.title: "RCI Tabung Haji tak panggil saya, jadi saya cerita di sini" - Bekas Ketua Audit Negara
videos.summary: Former Auditor-General of Malaysia provides first-hand details regarding the controversial 2017/2018 audit of Lembaga Tabung Haji. An essential watch for understanding financial governance and accountability in Malaysia's largest Islamic fund.

videos.title: Why You Can't Afford a Normal Life Anymore | Imam Tom Facchine
videos.summary: Imam Tom Facchine analyzes the spiritual and psychological toll of modern debt-driven economic systems. He offers an Islamic perspective on staying grounded, living within means, and preserving sanity in a high-cost environment.

videos.title: Is Any Income Actually Halal Anymore? | Signs of the Hour Ep. 15 | Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: Dr. Omar Suleiman explores the Prophetic warnings about modern wealth, questionable earnings, and the erosion of barakah in our income. A profound check for professionals striving to keep their career and earnings completely halal.

videos.title: Everyone Around You Is On A Clock Too | Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: It's easy to obsess over career milestones while delaying spiritual and family commitments. Dr. Omar Suleiman delivers a moving reminder that the time we have with aging parents and loved ones is limited, urging immediate action over future promises.

videos.title: All devs should learn Assembly
videos.summary: Casey Muratori argues why understanding hardware execution and low-level mechanics makes you a vastly better engineer. Gaining intuition for underlying computer architecture helps junior developers debug higher-level abstractions far faster.

videos.title: If you've been at the same company 3+ years, you're already in a box
videos.summary: Staying too comfortable early in your engineering career can stunt your professional growth. CTO Ian Miell explains why staying pushed outside your comfort zone is essential to building high-level system architectural thinking.

videos.title: How New Staff Engineers Build Judgment Without Years of Experience
videos.summary: Now that AI tooling handles basic boilerplate implementation, senior engineering is all about technical judgment and architecture. Big tech engineering leader Mallika Rao maps out how junior devs can intentionally cultivate judgment early.
